proves.claim: clause 1: new package <name> --purpose writes exactly the files newPackageFiles returns under packages/<name> and prints each path.

cli.io-commands-new.writes-anatomy-files.why: Without it, the command could write a different anatomy than the one the pure function declares.

proves.claim: clause 2: new package refuses NEW_PACKAGE_EXISTS and writes nothing when packages/<name> already exists.

cli.io-commands-new.refuses-existing-pac.why: Without it, a second run could overwrite a cell someone has already built.

proves.claim: clause 3: new refuses USAGE for a first word other than package, or with no name.

cli.io-commands-new.refuses-bad-usage.why: Without it, a typo could create a folder under a wrong name or none.
